name: Science and Technology
subject: Science and Technology
description: Here you will find the expectations and learning for the five areas of study for Grade 6.

strands.title: STEM Skills and Connections
strands.describer: Throughout Grade 6, in connection with the learning in the Life Systems, Matter and Energy, Structures and Mechanisms, and Earth and Space Systems strands, students will:

overall_expectations.title: STEM Investigation and Communication Skills
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 6, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures
overall_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process, a scientific experimentation process, and an engineering design process to conduct investigations, following appropriate health and safety procedures

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific research process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations
specific_expectations.text_html: use a scientific experimentation process and associated skills to conduct investigations

specific_expectations.text: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems
specific_expectations.text_html: use an engineering design process and associated skills to design, build, and test devices, models, structures, and/or systems

specific_expectations.text: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials
specific_expectations.text_html: follow established health and safety procedures during science and technology investigations, including wearing appropriate protective equipment and clothing and safely using tools, instruments, and materials

specific_expectations.text: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: communicate their findings, using science and technology vocabulary and formats that are appropriate for specific audiences and purposes

overall_expectations.title: Coding and Emerging Technologies
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 6, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields
overall_expectations.text_html: use coding in investigations and to model concepts, and assess the impact of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life and in STEM-related fields

specific_expectations.text: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on obtaining input in different ways for a variety of purposes
specific_expectations.text_html: write and execute code in investigations and when modelling concepts, with a focus on obtaining input in different ways for a variety of purposes

specific_expectations.text: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life, including skilled trades
specific_expectations.text_html: identify and describe impacts of coding and of emerging technologies on everyday life, including skilled trades

overall_expectations.title: Applications, Connections, and Contributions
overall_expectations.describer: Throughout Grade 6, in connection with the learning in the other strands, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the practical applications of science and technology, and of contributions to science and technology from people with diverse lived experiences

specific_expectations.text: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in various occupations, including skilled trades, and how these applications address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: describe practical applications of science and technology concepts in various occupations, including skilled trades, and how these applications address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems
specific_expectations.text_html: investigate how science and technology can be used with other subject areas to address real-world problems

specific_expectations.text: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse contributions to science and technology from various communities

strands.title: Life Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 6, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 6, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the importance of biodiversity, and describe ways of protecting biodiversity
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the importance of biodiversity, and describe ways of protecting biodiversity

specific_expectations.text: assess the benefits of biodiversity and the consequences of the diminishing of biodiversity
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the benefits of biodiversity and the consequences of the diminishing of biodiversity

specific_expectations.text: analyse a local issue related to biodiversity while considering different perspectives; plan a course of action in response to the issue; and act on their plan
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse a local issue related to biodiversity while considering different perspectives; plan a course of action in response to the issue; and act on their plan

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 6, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of biodiversity, its contributions to the stability of natural systems, and its benefits to humans
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of biodiversity, its contributions to the stability of natural systems, and its benefits to humans

specific_expectations.text: describe the distinguishing characteristics of different groups of organisms, and use these characteristics to further classify these organisms using a classification system
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the distinguishing characteristics of different groups of organisms, and use these characteristics to further classify these organisms using a classification system

specific_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of biodiversity as the diversity of life on Earth, including the diversity of organisms within species, among species in a community, and among communities and the habitats that support them
specific_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of biodiversity as the diversity of life on Earth, including the diversity of organisms within species, among species in a community, and among communities and the habitats that support them

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which biodiversity within species is essential for their survival
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which biodiversity within species is essential for their survival

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which biodiversity within and among communities is essential for maintaining the resilience of these communities
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which biodiversity within and among communities is essential for maintaining the resilience of these communities

specific_expectations.text: describe interrelationships within species, between species, and between species and their natural environment, and explain how these interrelationships sustain biodiversity
specific_expectations.text_html: describe interrelationships within species, between species, and between species and their natural environment, and explain how these interrelationships sustain biodiversity

specific_expectations.text: explain how invasive species reduce biodiversity in local environments
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how invasive species reduce biodiversity in local environments

specific_expectations.text: explain how climate change contributes to a loss of biodiversity, and describe the impact of this loss
specific_expectations.text_html: explain how climate change contributes to a loss of biodiversity, and describe the impact of this loss

specific_expectations.text: describe the importance of biodiversity in supporting agriculture, including Indigenous agriculture around the world
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the importance of biodiversity in supporting agriculture, including Indigenous agriculture around the world

strands.title: Matter and Energy
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 6, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 6, students will:
overall_expectations.text: evaluate the impact of the use and generation of electrical energy on society and the environment, and suggest ways to use electrical energy responsibly
overall_expectations.text_html: evaluate the impact of the use and generation of electrical energy on society and the environment, and suggest ways to use electrical energy responsibly

specific_expectations.text: assess the short- and long-term impacts of electrical energy generation technologies in Canada on society and the environment, including impacts on First Nations, Métis, and Inuit communities, and on climate change
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the short- and long-term impacts of electrical energy generation technologies in Canada on society and the environment, including impacts on First Nations, Métis, and Inuit communities, and on climate change

specific_expectations.text: assess choices that reduce personal use of electrical energy from both renewable and non-renewable sources, and advocate for the responsible use of electrical energy by the school community
specific_expectations.text_html: assess choices that reduce personal use of electrical energy from both renewable and non-renewable sources, and advocate for the responsible use of electrical energy by the school community

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 6, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the principles of electrical energy and its transformation into and from other forms of energy
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the principles of electrical energy and its transformation into and from other forms of energy

specific_expectations.text: explain commonly observed electrostatic phenomena, using the principles of static electricity
specific_expectations.text_html: explain commonly observed electrostatic phenomena, using the principles of static electricity

specific_expectations.text: describe current electricity, and compare and contrast current electricity with static electricity
specific_expectations.text_html: describe current electricity, and compare and contrast current electricity with static electricity

specific_expectations.text: identify materials that are good conductors of electric current and materials that are good insulators
specific_expectations.text_html: identify materials that are good conductors of electric current and materials that are good insulators

specific_expectations.text: describe how technologies transform various forms of energy into electrical energy
specific_expectations.text_html: describe how technologies transform various forms of energy into electrical energy

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which electrical energy is transformed into other forms of energy
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which electrical energy is transformed into other forms of energy

specific_expectations.text: explain the functions of the components of a simple electrical circuit
specific_expectations.text_html: explain the functions of the components of a simple electrical circuit

specific_expectations.text: distinguish between series and parallel circuits, and identify common uses of each type of circuit
specific_expectations.text_html: distinguish between series and parallel circuits, and identify common uses of each type of circuit

strands.title: Structures and Mechanisms
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 6, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 6, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the environmental impacts of flying machines
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the environmental impacts of flying machines

specific_expectations.text: assess the impacts on society of aviation technologies, while considering both local and global perspectives
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the impacts on society of aviation technologies, while considering both local and global perspectives

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 6, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the ways in which properties of air can be applied to the principles of flight and flying machines
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the ways in which properties of air can be applied to the principles of flight and flying machines

specific_expectations.text: identify flight-related applications of the properties of air
specific_expectations.text_html: identify flight-related applications of the properties of air

specific_expectations.text: describe the relationships between the four forces of flight – lift, weight, thrust, and drag – that make flight possible
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the relationships between the four forces of flight – lift, weight, thrust, and drag – that make flight possible

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which flying machines and various organisms use balanced and unbalanced forces to control their flight
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which flying machines and various organisms use balanced and unbalanced forces to control their flight

specific_expectations.text: describe ways in which the four forces of flight can be altered
specific_expectations.text_html: describe ways in which the four forces of flight can be altered

specific_expectations.text: describe characteristics and adaptations that enable organisms to fly
specific_expectations.text_html: describe characteristics and adaptations that enable organisms to fly

strands.title: Earth and Space Systems
strands.describer: By the end of Grade 6, students will:

overall_expectations.title: Relating Science and Technology to Our Changing World
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 6, students will:
overall_expectations.text: assess the impact of space exploration on humans, society, and the environment
overall_expectations.text_html: assess the impact of space exploration on humans, society, and the environment

specific_expectations.text: analyse the impact that conditions in space have on humans engaged in space exploration, and explain how humans meet their social, emotional, and physiological needs in space
specific_expectations.text_html: analyse the impact that conditions in space have on humans engaged in space exploration, and explain how humans meet their social, emotional, and physiological needs in space

specific_expectations.text: assess the role of space exploration technology in observing and understanding environmental changes on Earth, including climate change
specific_expectations.text_html: assess the role of space exploration technology in observing and understanding environmental changes on Earth, including climate change

specific_expectations.text: evaluate the social and environmental impacts of space exploration, while taking various perspectives into consideration
specific_expectations.text_html: evaluate the social and environmental impacts of space exploration, while taking various perspectives into consideration

overall_expectations.title: Exploring and Understanding Concepts
overall_expectations.describer: By the end of Grade 6, students will:
overall_expectations.text: demonstrate an understanding of the solar system, the phenomena that result from the movement of different bodies within it, and the technologies used in space exploration
overall_expectations.text_html: demonstrate an understanding of the solar system, the phenomena that result from the movement of different bodies within it, and the technologies used in space exploration

specific_expectations.text: identify components of the solar system, including the Sun, Earth and other planets, natural satellites, comets, asteroids, and meteoroids, and describe their main physical characteristics
specific_expectations.text_html: identify components of the solar system, including the Sun, Earth and other planets, natural satellites, comets, asteroids, and meteoroids, and describe their main physical characteristics

specific_expectations.text: distinguish between the concepts of mass and weight
specific_expectations.text_html: distinguish between the concepts of mass and weight

specific_expectations.text: describe the relationship between the force of gravity and the weight of a body
specific_expectations.text_html: describe the relationship between the force of gravity and the weight of a body

specific_expectations.text: identify the types of bodies in space that emit light and those that reflect light
specific_expectations.text_html: identify the types of bodies in space that emit light and those that reflect light

specific_expectations.text: describe various effects of the relative positions and motions of Earth, the Moon, and the Sun
specific_expectations.text_html: describe various effects of the relative positions and motions of Earth, the Moon, and the Sun

specific_expectations.text: identify various technologies used in space exploration, and describe how technological innovations have contributed to our understanding of space
specific_expectations.text_html: identify various technologies used in space exploration, and describe how technological innovations have contributed to our understanding of space
